channel.title: LUMIÈRE Human Hair Wigs
channel.description: Premium human hair wigs with HD lace and worldwide shipping.

item.title: The Cascade Wave — 13x6 HD Lace Deep Wave Human Hair Wig
item.description: A deep-wave human-hair wig with a full, defined texture and transparent 13x6 lace. The longer lace area offers flexible parting, while the adjustable cap helps you refine the fit.

item.title: The Platinum Bob — 13x4 HD Lace #613 Human Hair Bob
item.description: A straight #613 blonde human-hair bob with transparent 13x4 lace. Choose from four lengths and two density options for a shorter, polished silhouette.

item.title: The Signature Straight — 13x6 HD Lace Human Hair Wig
item.description: A straight human-hair wig with transparent 13x6 lace and flexible parting space. Available in two density options and lengths from 16 to 30 inches.

item.title: The Water Wave Bob — Short Human Hair Lace Wig
item.description: Soft water-wave texture in an easy short silhouette. Lightweight, face-framing, and ready for everyday wear, this human-hair bob gives natural movement with a polished finish.

item.title: The Bouncy Curl Closure — 5x5 Glueless Human Hair Wig
item.description: Soft, springy curls with a polished 5x5 closure finish. This glueless human-hair wig gives full 200% density, natural movement, and an easy wear-and-go fit.

item.title: The Champagne Body Wave — #613 Blonde Human Hair Wig
item.description: A luminous #613 blonde body-wave wig with soft movement and a polished 13x4 lace-front finish. Airy, bright, and easy to style with the natural softness of human hair.

item.title: The Honey Noir Straight — 1B/27 Highlight Human Hair Wig
item.description: A sleek 1B/27 highlight lace-front wig with honey-blonde ribbons through a natural noir base. Smooth, glossy, face-brightening, and polished for everyday wear.

item.title: The Burgundy Bob Closure — 5x5 Human Hair Bob Wig
item.description: A polished burgundy bob with a clean 5x5 closure and silky bone-straight finish. Short, glossy, and easy to wear with a rich wine-red color.
